# DRISHTI — instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before any change, read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root. It is the single
operating manual for every AI agent on this team: how to pick and claim a task (GitHub Issues), where the
plan is (`docs/team/TASKS.md`), how to log progress (`docs/team/log/`), and the project rules (never
accusing language, no private data in this public repo, only measured numbers).
